evidence: Static row; decided on the frozen bytes. (1) Name equals turing/<dirname>: task.toml `name = "turing/colderwater-playground-devtools"`; manifest.json `"task": "projects/colderwater-playground-devtools"`; the assignment states the snapshot directory `task` is not an identity defect. The slug has three hyphen tokens. (2) Description `"A browser code playground with a custom editor, formatting, multiple carets, isolated preview and saved revisions."` matches the actual axes: instruction.md line 1 (`small local playground for working on JavaScript and complete HTML files ... format it, make changes in several places ... run it beside the source ... keep the versions`), overview.md (`formatting, selection, multiple carets and undo`, `revision history`), security.md (`isolated browser preview`), ui.md (own DOM/canvas/SVG text model, no textarea/CodeMirror/Monaco). It quotes no criterion counts, so nothing to reconcile against the actual 1+2 gate, 42 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual criteria. (3) Keywords `["webdev", "turing", "full-stack", "custom-editor", "javascript", "html", "formatting", "code-playground", "devtools"]` keep the three template keywords and the task-specific ones all correspond to public requirements (.js/.html execution modes, Format document, custom editor, preview plus console). (4) Metadata: `difficulty = "hard"`; difficulty_explanation `custom code editor with selection, multi-caret undo and formatting, then integrating its exact source with isolated execution and revision-safe saving` names the same axes as the brief and the functional rubric; `category = "programming"` is the contract value; `tags` are byte-equal to the template; `provenance = "Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task."` and `arena_slice = "custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history"` describe this task. No CHANGE_ME placeholder remains and no other product name (search for coldwater/hireops/other slugs in the task tree found none). (5) Product name is spelled consistently as Colderwater everywhere it appears in the task: tests/app_context.md `Name: Colderwater playground`, solution/app/package.json `"name": "colderwater-playground-devtools"`, solution/app/index.html `<title>Colderwater Playground</title>`, src/app.tsx:147 h1 `Colderwater`. Counterexample search: looked for a leftover name from a sibling task, a stale count in the description, an axis claimed in metadata but absent from the brief (none: every named axis is in the six notes), and an axis in the brief contradicted by metadata (none). Notes, not defects: (a) the description describes the product generically and does not contain the word Colderwater; the name/slug carries it. (b) staged-task-contract.md:42 comments the description as `product, axes of difficulty, judge, dimension policy`; this description omits judge and dimension policy, but quality-checks.md:40 only requires that it `names this product and its actual axes`, and the template ships `CHANGE_ME`, so I do not treat it as a row 8 failure. (c) The spelling `coldwater` appears only in QC run ids and repair folder names outside the task (qc/runs/coldwater-strict-*, qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict, run-outputs/coldwater-playground-devtools); these are not shipped, but anyone packaging should not derive the slug from them. (d) The public notes never tell the builder the product name Colderwater; no criterion was found by my search that requires that name, so it is not an identity mismatch (naming demands in criteria belong to other rows). Evidence index: I recomputed SHA256 for run_golden.sh and the six results/*.json and they match the index; that evidence is not relevant to this static row. No runtime evidence is required for this row.
